name: Hexagonalize
description: Both clips turn into hexagons, crossfade, then sharpen again. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: steps
params.description: Number of hexagon sizes it steps through (0: smooth)

params.name: horizontal_hexagons
params.description: Number of hexagons across at the coarsest
